newsitem.title: USA: Interra comfortable with earnings estimate.
newsitem.headline: Interra comfortable with earnings estimate.

text.p: Interra Financial Inc said Wednesday it is reasonably comfortable with a 1997 earnings estimate of $4.00 a share.

"We'd be reasonably comfortable with ($4.00 earnings per share in 1997). That's in the ballpark," Irving Weiser, Interra chief executive, said in an interview after the company's annual shareholder meeting.
Weiser said fluctuating interest rates would make continued record quarters difficult for the company to achieve.
"Interest rates will be volatile," Weiser said. "If we get a choppy environment for 1997, which most of us expect, we'll get some of the same choppiness in the business."
He said the company has had three record quarters out of the last five.
"Most would say it's going to be tough to continue at that level and I wouldn't disagree with them," he said. "But we're going to continue to invest and we'll weather the storm."
